The workbook generation failed due to invalid Excel formulas in the statistics section, resulting in #NAME? errors.
The test_derived_values_and_stats failed with an AssertionError in /tests/test_outputs.py. Specifically, cells H46 through L47 returned #NAME? instead of the expected float values (e.g., H46 expected -2.7657, got #NAME?). This indicates that the formulas written to the 'Task' worksheet use undefined names, incorrect function syntax, or missing references. Other tests for file structure and lookup blocks passed, suggesting the core issue is isolated to the statistics calculation logic.
